newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.396 billion yuan from 2.516 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said the market was less active than on Monday, largely because some banks cut their volumes, but regional short-term financial centres continued to trade actively.
Some short-term centres in the grain producing provinces continued to be active borrowers and the eastern coastal provinces were major sellers, they said.

"When the end of the month approaches, demand for funds from financial institutions increases sharply, which will give both the rates and volume some support in the next few days," said one local trader.
Traders said they expected turnover and rates to remain around current levels.
